name: National Emergency Response Support System (ERSS)
description: Pan-India single emergency response number for citizens in emergencies requiring immediate assistance from Police, Fire, Health, and other agencies.
authority: Ministry of Home Affairs

name: Police Emergency Helpline
description: Traditional national emergency number to contact the local police control room for immediate security and law enforcement assistance.
authority: State Police Departments

verification.notes: Verified standard police control room code.

name: Fire Services Helpline
description: Direct emergency contact number for reporting fire incidents, structural collapses, and requesting search and rescue operations.
authority: State Fire and Rescue Services

name: Maternity & General Ambulance Helpline
description: National helpline number specifically dedicated to dispatching basic life support ambulances, primarily focused on pregnant women (JSSK scheme) and infants.
authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

name: Emergency Disaster & Medical Ambulance Service
description: A free emergency response service primarily handling life-threatening medical emergencies, road accidents, and disaster situations requiring advanced life support.
authority: State Health Departments / National Health Mission

verification.notes: Verified against NHM 108 Emergency Service operations.

name: Childline India
description: A 24-hour, toll-free, emergency phone outreach service for children in need of care and protection.
authority: Ministry of Women and Child Development

officialSources.sourceName: Ministry of Women and Child Development

name: Women Helpline (WHL) / Sakhi
description: Toll-free 24-hours telecom service to provide support and information to women affected by violence, integrated with One Stop Centres (Sakhi).
authority: Ministry of Women and Child Development
services: Rescue and Shelter Linkage (One Stop Centre)

officialSources.sourceName: Ministry of Women and Child Development

verification.notes: Verified against MoWCD Universalization of Women Helpline scheme.

name: Women Police Helpline
description: An emergency police helpline dedicated exclusively to women in distress facing harassment, eve-teasing, or immediate physical threat.
authority: State Police Departments

name: National Cyber Crime Financial Fraud Reporting Helpline
description: A dedicated toll-free helpline operated by I4C to report online financial frauds immediately to help authorities freeze the defrauded money.
authority: Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C), Ministry of Home Affairs

name: Tele-MANAS (Mental Health Helpline)
description: National Tele Mental Health Assistance and Networking Across States providing free, 24x7 mental health support, counseling, and crisis intervention.
authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

name: Elderline (National Helpline for Senior Citizens)
description: A pan-India toll-free helpline providing information, guidance, emotional support, and field intervention to senior citizens facing abuse or neglect.
authority: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

name: MANAS National Narcotics Helpline
description: A toll-free helpline allowing citizens to anonymously report drug trafficking, illicit cultivation, and seek de-addiction and rehabilitation guidance.
authority: Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB), Ministry of Home Affairs

verification.notes: Verified against MHA / NCB MANAS launch.

name: National Health Helpline
description: Central helpline operated by the Ministry of Health to provide information on public health emergencies, infectious diseases (like COVID-19), and blood donation.
authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

officialSources.sourceName: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

verification.notes: Verified against MoHFW emergency contact lists.

name: Rail Madad (Railway Security & Helpline)
description: An integrated, single-number helpline for Indian Railways passengers addressing security, medical assistance, complaints, and general inquiries.
authority: Ministry of Railways
services: Security and Medical Assistance on Train

verification.notes: Verified against Indian Railways single helpline integration.

name: Central Relief Commissioner / Disaster Helpline
description: Toll-free emergency number at the state/central level to coordinate relief operations and rescue requests during natural calamities (floods, cyclones, earthquakes).
authority: National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA) / State Relief Commissioners

name: District Disaster Control Room Helpline
description: Helpline directly connecting citizens to their local District Magistrate's emergency control room during localized emergencies and severe weather events.
authority: District Administration / State Disaster Management Authorities

name: National Power / Electricity Helpline
description: A centralized helpline number for addressing consumer grievances related to power failures, electrical emergencies, and billing issues across various DISCOMs.
authority: Ministry of Power / State Electricity Boards

verification.notes: Verified standard national electricity grievance shortcode.

name: National Consumer Helpline (NCH)
description: Toll-free helpline guiding consumers on their rights, advising them on grievance redressal, and registering complaints against misleading advertisements or deficient services.
authority: Department of Consumer Affairs
availability: 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM (All days except National Holidays)

name: LPG Gas Leakage Emergency Helpline
description: A centralized, round-the-clock emergency response number for reporting LPG gas leakages, functional across all major Oil Marketing Companies (Indane, HP, Bharat Gas).
authority: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas

officialSources.sourceName: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas

verification.notes: Verified standard MoPNG LPG emergency code.

name: NHAI Highway Emergency Helpline
description: National helpline to assist highway users in reporting accidents, requesting medical/towing assistance, or raising toll plaza and FASTag-related grievances on National Highways.
authority: National Highways Authority of India (NHAI)

name: Kisan Call Centre (KCC)
description: A dedicated toll-free helpline providing immediate expert advisory services to farmers on crop diseases, pest control, weather, and market prices.
authority: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

name: DigiSaathi (Digital Payments Helpline)
description: An automated 24x7 helpline assisting users with queries on various digital payment products and services, acting as a unified platform for NPCI, RBI, and bank guidelines.
authority: National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) / RBI

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Helpline
description: National helpline for queries, complaints, and information regarding the Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana health insurance scheme.
authority: National Health Authority (NHA)

name: UIDAI Aadhaar Helpline
description: Official toll-free helpline number for residents to inquire about Aadhaar enrolment, update status, PVC card tracking, and authentication issues.
authority: Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI)
availability: 24x7 (IVRS), Agent available 7 AM to 11 PM (Monday-Saturday) and 8 AM to 5 PM (Sunday)

name: State Health Information Helpline
description: A state-level non-emergency medical helpline offering medical advice from doctors, counseling, and information on health services, blood banks, and government schemes.
authority: State Health Departments / NHM

verification.notes: Verified as NHM standard non-emergency health shortcode.

name: National Toll-Free Helpline for Drug De-addiction
description: A national helpline setup to provide counseling, crisis intervention, and guidance on de-addiction and rehabilitation resources to substance dependents and their families.
authority: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment (MoSJE)

verification.notes: Verified against MoSJE Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan guidelines.

name: Railway Accident Emergency Info Helpline
description: Specific emergency control room helpline activated during train accidents or derailments to provide information on casualties, rescue operations, and passenger status to relatives.
authority: Ministry of Railways

verification.notes: Verified standard Railway Accident emergency code.

name: Road Accident Emergency Helpline
description: An emergency helpline for reporting road and traffic accidents to dispatch immediate medical aid, police assistance, and traffic clearance teams.
authority: Traffic Police / State Transport Departments

verification.notes: Verified standard road accident emergency code.

name: Women Power Line (WPL)
description: An established, toll-free police-administered contact center specifically designed to combat harassment (phone, cyber, or physical) against women by providing immediate police intervention without necessitating an immediate FIR.
authority: State Police Departments (Originated in UP)

verification.notes: Verified against UP Police Women Power Line framework.

name: KIRAN - Mental Health Helpline
description: A 24x7 toll-free mental health rehabilitation helpline launched to offer early screening, first-aid, psychological support, distress management, and mental well-being promotion.
authority: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD), Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment

verification.notes: Verified against MSJE KIRAN helpline launch documentation.
